content:
Based on the provided screenshot of the **EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free** application, here is a precise UI audit.

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Context:** 1024x768 maximized window. The main application is dimmed (overlay state).
*   **Modal Dialog (Center):** 
    *   **Bounds:** Approx [184, 136] to [800, 686] (Width: 616px, Height: 550px).
    *   **Structure:** Header (Icon + Title + Close), Body (Warning text), Action Grid (3 rows of prompts + CTA buttons).
    *   **Alignment:** Centered horizontally and vertically within the viewport. Content is left-aligned with consistent left padding (~40px). Buttons are right-aligned within their respective rows.
*   **Background App (Dimmed):**
    *   **Top Bar:** [0, 0] to [1024, 55]. Contains App Icon/Title (Left), "Buy Now" badge, Nav icons, Window controls (Right).
    *   **Address Bar:** [0, 65] to [1024, 115]. Breadcrumb navigation.
    *   **Sidebar (Left):** [0, 135] to [180, 835]. Tree view of scan locations ("Path").
    *   **Main Content (Right):** [190, 135] to [1024, 835]. File list view.
    *   **Status Bar (Bottom):** [0, 850] to [1024, 930]. Scan status summary and "Recover All..." button.

### 2) TEXT
**Modal Dialog:**
*   **Headline:** `Wait! You are at risk of losing data!`
*   **Body:** `1139246 files (146.41 GB) have been found.More than 50% of permanent data loss occurs because unrecovered files get overwritten by continued computer use.` *(Note: Missing space after period in source)*
*   **Sub-headline:** `Take the final step now to safely secure your data.`
*   **Row 1 Label:** `Price too high?` | **Button:** `Get Up to 40% Off`
*   **Row 2 Label:** `Can't find your lost data?` | **Button:** `Online Service`
*   **Row 3 Label:** `Really want to quit?` | **Button:** `Quit`

**Background Application:**
*   **Title:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Address:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Sidebar:** `Path`, `Windows (C:)`, `File Path Lost`, `Reconstructed`
*   **List Item:** `actionarchivecache` (Folder Name)
*   **Details:** `Size: 284 MB`, `Date Modified: 10/7/2026 11:30 PM`, `Path: C:\`
*   **Buttons:** `Filter`, `Open`, `Buy Now`
*   **Footer:** `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139246 (146.41 GB)`
*   **System:** `Search`, `7:28 PM`, `10/17/2026`

### 3) COLOR
*   **Dialog Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Dialog Overlay:** `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)` (Dark transparent grey dimming background app)
*   **Primary Text:** `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
*   **Secondary Text:** `#666666` or `#555555` (Dark Grey)
*   **Accent Blue (Text/Links):** `#0078D4` (Standard Windows Blue)
*   **Accent Blue (UI Elements):** `#2563EB` (Vibrant Blue for Icons/Buttons)
*   **CTA Button (Orange):**
    *   *Background:* Linear Gradient from `#FFB84D` (Light Orange) to `#FF9900` (Deep Orange). Direction: Left-to-Right.
    *   *Text:* `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Secondary Button (Light Blue):**
    *   *Background:* `#E6F0FF` (Pale Blue)
    *   *Text:* `#0055CC` (Link Blue)
*   **Row Highlight (Grey):** `#F5F7FA` (Very Light Grey)

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Headline (Dialog):** Segoe UI / System Sans-Serif, ~16px-18px, **Bold** (Weight 700).
*   **Body Text:** Segoe UI, ~13px-14px, Regular (Weight 400). Line height approx 1.5.
*   **Row Labels:** Segoe UI, ~14px, Regular.
*   **Button Text:** Segoe UI, ~13px-14px, Semi-bold (Weight 600).

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Dialog Padding:** Internal padding ~40px on all sides.
*   **Header Height:** ~60px (from top edge to title baseline).
*   **Action Rows:** Height ~70px each. Vertical gap between rows ~12px.
*   **Buttons:**
    *   Width: ~160px (Orange), ~140px (Blue).
    *   Height: ~36px - 40px.
    *   Border Radius: ~4px - 6px (Slightly rounded rectangles).
*   **Close Icon ('X'):** Top-right corner, ~16x16px clickable area, icon size ~10x10px.
*   **Main Icon (Hourglass):** ~64x64px bounding box.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Dialog Container:** Modal, Active (blocking interaction with parent).
*   **Close Button ('X'):** Top-right. State: Normal.
*   **"Get Up to 40% Off" Button:** State: Normal (Enabled). Style: Filled, Gradient.
*   **"Online Service" Button:** State: Normal (Enabled). Style: Ghost/Light Fill.
*   **"Quit" Button:** State: Normal (Enabled). Style: Ghost/Light Fill.
*   **Background Controls:** All visually disabled/inactive due to overlay dimming.
    *   "Recover All..." button: Visible but obscured.
    *   File List Checkboxes: Unchecked.

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Vector-based, "Fluent Design" influence (filled/accent style).
*   **Hourglass Icon (Dialog):** Blue gradient fill (`#4DAFFF` to `#0078D4`). Represents "Time/Risk".
*   **Tag Icon (Price row):** Small pink/red tag icon next to "Price too high?".
*   **App Icons (Background):**
    *   Folder: Standard yellow folder outline/fill.
    *   Checkmark (Footer): Green circle with white check (Success state).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page Level:** **Retention / Upsell Gate (Interruptive)**.
*   **Context:** The user has completed a file scan (indicated by footer text "Scan Completed") and likely attempted to close the application or proceed to recovery without purchasing. This dialog acts as a "Churn Blocker".
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot).

### Specific Focus Items (Per Request)
*   **Destination Dialog:** Present and centered. It is an **Upsell/Retention Modal**, not a standard destination picker.
*   **Local/Cloud Tabs:** Not present in this specific modal. (The background app shows local drive `C:`).
*   **Drive Rows:** Not present inside this modal.
*   **Choose folder row:** Not present inside this modal.
*   **Enable-file-repair toggle:** Not present inside this modal.
*   **Save button:** Not present inside this modal. (The "Quit" button serves as the dismissal action).
*   **Warnings:** The headline `Wait! You are at risk of losing data!` serves as the primary warning.
*   **Insufficient-space gate copy:** Not applicable; this is a **Purchase Incentive** gate.
    *   **Headline:** `Wait! You are at risk of losing data!`
    *   **Body:** `1139246 files... get overwritten by continued computer use.`
    *   **Primary CTA:** `Get Up to 40% Off` (Price objection handling).
    *   **Secondary CTA:** `Online Service` (Support objection handling).
    *   **Tertiary CTA:** `Quit` (Exit intent handling).
